drawing_rules: Use this neutral frame as the only anatomical scale reference for every action.
Never enlarge or shrink the head, torso, skirt, arms, hands, thighs, calves, or boots between states.
Pose changes may translate and rotate linked body segments, but their lengths and thicknesses stay fixed.
Standing entry and exit poses use sole baseline y=202 and hair top near y=6.
Running and jumping may bend the legs or lift the whole body; apparent height may change only through articulation or vertical translation.
Perspective foreshortening is allowed only on the forward fist-bump forearm and fist; head and torso scale remain canonical.
Keep the red chest pin on Marina's right side and do not mirror directional rows.
